CUSTOMCHARACTERKIRBY-META_KNIGHT_DUEL.pa:
You come across a lone swordsman practicing his sword swings.

“Hey, you. You look like you can handle yourself in a fight. Would you care for a duel with me?”

He looks pretty skilled but a duel sounds fun.

The swordsman nods and takes a battle stance.

“This duel won't be to the death, but I won't hold back. FIGHT ME!”

The swordsman nods.

“Very well, run along then.”

“You must train harder to get on my level.”

The swordsman turns around and walks away.

“You fought well. I'll aid you in battle.”

The swordsman shakes your hand and goes back to practicing.
